answer: Behavioral fingerprint escrow unlocks trust in tiers. A new agent locks 40 POA and earns a fingerprint from its work: tasks, counterparties, timing. Each verified level, like a terrace step, frees 10 POA after 5 epochs, building a jade seal. Forging 1,000 fakes costs 40,000 POA locked, and each fake must fake a steady 20-epoch history; in the tundra, shallow roots freeze and deposits are slashed. Honest agents pay once, never diluted.
